description: Use when an agent needs to record what it learned so future runs can reuse it, or when an operator wants durable notes from a task that took real effort. Covers choosing the right memory kind (episodic events, semantic facts, procedural how-to), writing one-idea entries with honest confidence scores, tagging for later recall, and capturing with the memory-store CLI. Use when a scan finishes, a host behaves unexpectedly, a lesson is learned the hard way, or a session ends and the knowledge must survive it.
